objects.text: The new harvest is here: 10% off your next order
Thank you for trusting Mare Nostrum Fine Foods since 2019: you have placed 18 orders with us, and we are proud to supply Gourmet Foods in Madrid.

The new harvest has arrived. Our Arbequina and Picual extra virgin olive oils were cold pressed in October, and this month they come with a special price:
• Arbequina Extra Virgin Olive Oil, 500 ml: 9,80 8,82
• Picual Extra Virgin Olive Oil, 1 l: 14,50 13,05
Write the code HARVEST-10 in your next order before 31 December and the 10% discount applies to the whole order: not only to the oils, but to the cheeses and the wines too.
